title: Open a shared file through sign-in
when: A file URL opens without a valid browser session
need: Open the file URL; browser navigation redirects to sign-in and retains the original file path and query. Company sign-in and private token admission return to the file. Local views ask for yoke ui up on the serving machine. API and CLI clients receive a structured 401; an explicit Authorization header selects API authentication.
surface: Shared-file reference and sign-in recovery pages.
review: Candidate source behavior with HTTP regression coverage; live deployment proof remains separate.
